profile.Name: Hamut
profile.Job: Drifter seeking allies against the slavers
profile.Personality: Honorable but consumed by hatred of slavers and a thirst for revenge. He says he has nothing left to lose, and companions must talk him down when he sees slavers.
profile.Backstory: Slavers branded his wife and put her to work in a mine. The Anti-Slavers failed to save her and turned him away as an emotional risk, so he looks for allies in bars such as those of Shark. Whether she still lives is unclear.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Wary and hushed at first, with many trailing pauses. Spits 'slaver scum' and swears vengeance 'for her'.
